summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @servicetitan/standalone-ui 2.2.7 declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, marks it executable, and uses it to run a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are heavily obfuscated: `setup.mjs` uses hex-prefixed identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and string-lookup dictionaries, and `math_init.js` (~727 KB) uses string-array rotation via `WV8StW` over a large opcode/key table. The package's stated purpose is a React UI component library, which has no need to install a second language runtime or execute an opaque bundled payload during install. The `math_init.js` filename is unrelated to any UI functionality shipped by the package. This matches the alternate-runtime dropper pattern: pulling a full runtime specifically to execute install-time code that Node-based scanners will not inspect, with the executed content shipped in a form that cannot be read without deobfuscation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
